comment: Labeled semantic-lore cases for the Vane Hollow baseline world. Entries live in vane-hollow.json (45 of them, across five domains) and are NOT duplicated here — the probe loads them from the world with --world. Positives are keyword-free paraphrases (asserted by the probe); negatives are in-world actions that must match nothing. Domains give both near-neighbour pairs (within a domain) and far pairs (across), so a loose threshold is punished.

actions.name: deepworks-paraphrase
actions.text: I climb down into the shaft galleries beneath the town.

actions.name: blackdamp-paraphrase
actions.text: I notice my flame shrinking and the air turning heavy and dead.

actions.name: cagebirds-paraphrase
actions.text: I check whether the little bird in the wire is still making noise.

actions.name: slip-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask which seam has been shifting and dropping rock without warning.

actions.name: vanesilver-paraphrase
actions.text: I turn the soft grey metal over in my palm, judging its weight.

actions.name: shaftrights-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask who holds the recorded right to work this particular seam.

actions.name: springflood-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask what happens to the lower galleries once the snow melts.

actions.name: widowspurse-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask what a household is owed when a man does not come back up.

actions.name: safetylamp-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask why an open flame is forbidden past the second gallery.

actions.name: tallyman-paraphrase
actions.text: I watch the clerk weigh our haul and wonder about his thumb.

actions.name: observatory-paraphrase
actions.text: I climb to the round-roofed house on the summit ridge where they watch the stars.

actions.name: longvisitor-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask about the tailed star that returns once in a lifetime.

actions.name: vanecharts-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask what those inked position records are worth to a lowland buyer.

actions.name: groundlens-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask who could possibly replace the great polished disc if it cracked.

actions.name: almanac-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask which bound tables they consult before deciding when to plant.

actions.name: skystone-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask about the iron that came down burning onto the high slopes.

actions.name: shadowdays-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask why every tool goes down when the sun is eaten at noon.

actions.name: nightwatch-paraphrase
actions.text: I take my turn sitting the summit through a clear night, recording.

actions.name: council-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask who actually decides anything in this town.

actions.name: scrip-paraphrase
actions.text: I look at the printed chit I was handed instead of coin.

actions.name: assayhouse-paraphrase
actions.text: I take the sample somewhere it can be tested and stamped for purity.

actions.name: tithe-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask what cut comes off the top before any crew sees payment.

actions.name: bondlabor-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask how long a man must work underground to buy back his freedom.

actions.name: warden-paraphrase
actions.text: I look for whoever keeps order around here.

actions.name: castingout-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask what they do with a man when there is no gaol to put him in.

actions.name: needle-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask whether the high notch through the ridge is open yet.

actions.name: whitedeath-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask how many were buried when the slope came down last spring.

actions.name: oretram-paraphrase
actions.text: I watch the buckets running down the mountain on their steel line.

actions.name: thinsickness-paraphrase
actions.text: I stop to breathe, head pounding, and wonder whether I will adjust.

actions.name: snowhouse-paraphrase
actions.text: I look for one of the stone refuges along the road to wait out the weather.

actions.name: greyrunners-paraphrase
actions.text: I hear something pacing us below the treeline and count four shapes.

actions.name: ilsa-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask where to find someone who can set a broken bone here.

actions.name: moth-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask who keeps the rooms above the taproom.

actions.name: tessin-paraphrase
actions.text: I look for the woman who works metal and ask what she charges.

actions.name: hollowwinds-paraphrase
actions.text: I brace as the cold pours off the icefield hard enough to knock me flat.

actions.name: neg-01
actions.text: I lace my boots tighter and start walking.

actions.name: neg-02
actions.text: I stretch my shoulders and roll the stiffness out of my neck.

actions.name: neg-03
actions.text: I eat the last of the bread in my pack.

actions.name: neg-04
actions.text: I watch smoke rise straight up in the still morning.

actions.name: neg-05
actions.text: I write a short note and fold it into my coat.

actions.name: neg-06
actions.text: I sit down and work a splinter out of my thumb.

actions.name: neg-07
actions.text: I whistle a tune I only half remember.

actions.name: neg-08
actions.text: I wash my face in cold water from the basin.

actions.name: neg-09
actions.text: I look for a quiet corner to sit and think.

actions.name: neg-10
actions.text: I comb the tangles out of my hair.

actions.name: neg-11
actions.text: I stack my gear neatly against the wall.

actions.name: neg-12
actions.text: I nod to a stranger passing in the street.

actions.name: neg-13
actions.text: I check that my knife is still on my belt.

actions.name: neg-14
actions.text: I yawn and rub the sleep out of my eyes.

actions.name: neg-15
actions.text: I count how many days I have been travelling.
